title: Credible Sources, Licensing, and Credit
prerequisites: Identify a source title and link
Use three teacher-assigned source cards or webpages
objectives: Evaluate a source by checking author, date, evidence, and purpose.
Choose a source that fits a specific research question.
Distinguish ownership, permission, license, and credit.
Write a traceable media or data credit.
evidence: Saved three-source evaluation, source decision, and complete credit

requirements.account: No account required for module practice
requirements.storage: Progress remains in this browser and device
requirements.offline: Use printed source cards and the four-part credibility and media-credit checks.

formalAssessment: Separate teacher directions and rubric are required.
